dialogues.speaker: NPC#22770
dialogues.text: Anyone up for a challenge? One that'll train your eye at the same time? Beat the challenge, and this amazing chest over here is yours~

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We are! We're ready to take on the challenge!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#22770
dialogues.text: Oh...? Wonderful. I am Kruzhkova. How about the two of you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #My name's Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#22770
dialogues.text: #Okay, okay, Paimon and {NICKNAME}. I got it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...So eh, the "generous rewards" you were talking about, the chest — how do we get our hands on that?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#22770
dialogues.text: Oh, that's easy! First, please take a look at this next to me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Do you really have to act so surprised...

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: Yes, that's what it looks like, doesn't it? Just an ordinary old train. It's actually a piece of jun—— ahem, we picked up from the train boneyard, and for a pretty penny, too...

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: But that's beside the point. Anyway, this may look like an ordinary train to you, but it's actually a "Jack Frost train"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A Jack Frost train?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, is it the chassis that's made by Jack Frosts, are we talking about the wheels here...?

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: No, no, no. It's a train packed full of Jack Frosts. Mind you, it took me quite a bit of effort to catch... er, I mean invite all these Jack Frosts from all over...

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: Anyway, the challenge is a simple one: all you have to do is drive the train out. I'll start my countdown, and you have to count exactly how many Jack Frosts there are on the train before it ends!

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: So, what do you think? Up for training your eye? But because acquiring that train and setting up the venue has cost quite a bit, there's actually a fee if you wanna take part.

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: But at 1,000 Mora a try, it really is quite a steal.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohhhhhhhhh. So it's that kind of challenge, huh...

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: So, how about it? Wanna give it a go?

choices.text: Yeah, let's give it a shot then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #1,000 Mora, you said? Paimon will pay that on {NICKNAME}'s behalf! And if we really get that reward later...

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: I'm sure you will, my dear little adorable miss. You remind me of a Jack Frost yourself!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Awesome! And when we get that reward later, {NICKNAME}, you're buying Paimon something yummy!

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: Okay then. Now, would the two of you stand over there please... The challenge is about to begin.

choices.text: No, I've got other things to attend to right now...

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: Oh, that's a pity. But that's alright, I'll be here for a while still. Remember to come back when you've got some time!

choices.text: Oh, it's some kind of life form that's been transformed into a train...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Does such a thing even exist...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This looks like just an ordinary train to Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#22770
dialogues.text: Come try the "Count the Jack Frosts" challenge! Only 1,000 Mora a try! You get a generous reward if you win!

choices.text: Yeah, let's give it a shot then!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #1,000 Mora, you said? Paimon will pay that on {NICKNAME}'s behalf! And if we really get that reward later...

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: I'm sure you will, my dear little adorable miss. You remind me of a Jack Frost yourself!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Awesome! And when we get that reward later, {NICKNAME}, you're buying Paimon something yummy!

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: Okay then. Now, would the two of you stand over there please... The challenge is about to begin.

choices.text: No, I've got other things to attend to right now...

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: Oh, that's a pity. But that's alright, I'll be here for a while still. Remember to come back when you've got some time!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#22770
dialogues.text: So, how did it go? Did you manage to count them? So, um, how many of those... of that kind of Jack Frosts do you think you saw?

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: Oh no! I'm afraid you got the number wrong. Looks like you missed out on that reward.

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: Oh dear, I'm afraid you got the number wrong! Maybe you didn't hear me clearly just now — I did not ask how many Jack Frosts there are on the train earlier.

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: I asked you to tell me how many Jack Frosts of that type... the ones with the hats on... you saw on the train.

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: Looks like you missed out on that reward.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whaaat!? What kind of a... You should've started it more clearly just now!

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: Oh, you should have chewed on it a little more.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: F—fine! We'll try again then! And this time, we'll definitely get it right!

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: So, the fee...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon will pay it! Hmph, now that we know you only want us to count the Jack Frosts wearing hats, we won't get it wrong this time!

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: Wow, what a generous challenger you are! I wish you every success in that case then...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Thankfully, the fraud has not gotten far, and the two of you catch up with her and bring her back to the train..

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I want all my Mora back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You horrible, horrible cheat!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#22770
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I was wrong... I didn't think you'd catch up with me...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#22770
dialogues.text: Please, forgive me! Honestly, I haven't conned that many people!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What the...! Just exactly how many people were you planning to con!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just one is bad enough!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#22770
dialogues.text: *Wail* I—I—I won't do it again! Promise!!!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#22770
dialogues.text: I used to be an Adventurers' Guild member myself, you know. And there was this one time, when I encountered a pack of Fluffahogs amidst a snowy night on the tundra.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#22770
dialogues.text: They came rolling on, like a cannonball made of giant spikes, and I was left a right sobbing mess by the end of the chase...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#22770
dialogues.text: Ever since then, I've sworn to myself that I'd sca—— earn enough Mora to pay other adventurers to drive every last one of those Fluffahogs away...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But there are so many honest ways you can earn Mora... And what about those Jack Frosts on the train?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#22770
dialogues.text: I told them that they could find yummy food on the train, and they came pouring in...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh. Paimon sees how they could've fallen for that, yeah. Don't you dare cheat anyone else from now on! And let those Jack Frosts go!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#22770
dialogues.text: Y—Yes...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The cheat known as Kruzhkova releases the Jack Frosts.\nShe also promises again and again to never defraud others again and to engage in only honest work from now on...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: It is only at this point that the Jack Frosts realize that they were lied to.\nTo thank you for rescuing them, they hand you some shiny buttons.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... These buttons, are the Jack Frosts giving them to us to thank us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh! It makes Paimon so mad, just thinking about that cheat... And those Jack Frosts! Paimon hopes they never get conned like that again!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#22770
dialogues.text: So, how did it go? Did you manage to count them? So, um, how many Jack Frosts wearing hats do you think you saw?

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: *Sigh* You were so, so close...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Paimon thinks something isn't quite right here! No, let's give it another try!

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: Alright, alright. Now that you've paid the fee, you may continue...

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: *Sigh* You were so, so close...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Paimon thinks something isn't quite right here! No, let's give it another try!

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: Alright, alright. Now that you've paid the fee, you may continue...

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: Hmm... So what's the correct answer...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, this time round Paimon decided to count them for herself too! There are 5 Jack Frosts on the train that were wearing hats! And that's exactly what you said just now: "Jack Frosts wearing hats"!

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: Yes! The correct answer is... 5!

response.speaker: NPC#22770
response.text: In that case, here's your challenge reward! And please excuse me, for I have to go now!
